description: This file contains functions for transforming and optimizing torch.fx computational graphs, specifically merging multiple matrix multiplication operations sharing the same right-hand side operand into a single operation.

methods.name: split_result_tensors
methods.description: Splits a merged matmul result tensor into individual results based on input tensor shapes.

methods.name: may_depend_on
methods.description: Determines if one fx Node depends on another within a certain search depth.

methods.name: are_nodes_independent
methods.description: Checks if a list of fx Nodes are pairwise independent (no dependencies).

methods.name: merge_matmul
methods.description: Transforms a torch.nn.Module's graph by merging multiple matmul nodes sharing the same RHS into a single matmul operation.
